newsitem.title: USA: Ohio corn seedings jump to 90 percent complete.
newsitem.headline: Ohio corn seedings jump to 90 percent complete.

text.p: Corn seeding in Ohio jumped to 90 percent complete during the week ended Sunday, according to the Ohio Agricultural Statistics Service.
That tally was sharply above year-ago plantings of nine percent and well above the average pace of 62 percent.
Soybean seedings were 55 percent complete, above the zero percent a year earlier and above the 33 percent average.
Twenty-one percent of the corn crop had emerged and four percent of the soybean crop had emerged.
Winter wheat was 10 percent excellent, 41 percent good, 37 percent fair, 10 percent poor and two percent very poor. Ninety percent of the wheat crop was jointed and one percent was headed.
Topsoil moisture levels were 15 percent surplus, 79 percent adequate and six percent short.
